incidents.summary: A Saudi court denied GMS's appeal against a $9.2 million tax assessment concerning inter-group transfer pricing between 2017 and 2019, with the final judgment amount not yet communicated.

sources.title: Gulf Marine Services seeks legal advice on general meeting request | AJ Bell
sources.quote: The Abu Dhabi-based provider of self-propelled and self-elevating support vessels for the offshore energy sector said its appeal has been denied by a court in relation to a $9.2 million tax assessment received in 2021 from the Saudi Zakat, Tax & Customs Authority.

sources.title: Gulf Marine Services seeks legal advice on general meeting request | AJ Bell
sources.quote: The amount relates to the transfer pricing of an inter-group bareboat agreement between 2017 and 2019.

sources.title: National  Storage Mechanism | Additional information
sources.quote: The total amount awarded under the judgment against the Group is yet to be communicated to us and management will work on obtaining a waiver of the penalties.
